personality: 7 Dark-First Utility structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A premium NEXA-inspired logistics command center balancing stark industrial utility with high-end glass aesthetics and electric lime accents.

spacing.rule: Use base-8 industrial grid. Compact layouts but strictly maintain text visibility and touch target (44x44pt). Handle padding subtly for geometric cards.

do's: Use approximately 12% milky-white translucent gloss overlaid on charcoal/graphite for premium elevation.
Apply glass effects strictly to elevated overlay surfaces: bottom sheet headers, floating map widgets (e.g., zoom/center controls), and the bottom tab bar.
Ensure underlying tint opacity is at least 75% surface color in dark mode to maintain readability.
dont's: Do not sacrifice text visibility for glass effects.
Do not blur primary interactive form fields or body text regions.

screens.name: Common OTP Login
screens.purpose: A unified, high-security entry point for all 13 roles.

states.loading: Subtle Electric Lime spinner against charcoal background.
states.error: Signal red toast/message with retry CTA.

screens.layout: Hero graphic at top (using premium textured dark background). Clean input form for phone number. Large, sticky Electric Lime primary CTA at bottom above keyboard (via KeyboardAvoidingView). Post-OTP entry transitions seamlessly without artificial delays.

screens.name: Customer Dashboard Shell
screens.purpose: A map-centric dashboard to track live concrete orders, manage digital challans, and view KYC status.

states.loading: Skeleton UI over map and list layers.
states.empty: Empty state illustration with 'No active orders' and 'Place Order' CTA.
states.error: Error modal for connectivity loss over map.

screens.layout: Full-bleed map interface for active transit mixer tracking. A premium glassmorphic bottom sheet (using @gorhom/bottom-sheet) displays active order telemetry (ETA, quantity). Floating glass chips on the map for quick filters. Max 4 bottom tabs (Home, Orders, Challans, Profile). Status badges use strict color coding (e.g., Warning Amber for 'In Transit', Success Mint for 'Delivered').

hero_texture.alt: Abstract dark charcoal premium texture for splash/hero

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: Charcoal/Graphite base with Electric Lime accent. No indigo, blue, or purple anywhere in the UI.
Implement the 12% milky-white translucent glass effect strictly on elevated surfaces (bottom sheets, tab bar) using expo-blur, ensuring high text contrast.
Status Indicator System: Orders use solid badges. Pending/Warning (Amber), Transit (Electric Lime or Info White), Delivered (Mint Green).
KYC Status System: Unverified (Signal Red), Pending (Amber), Verified (Mint Green) using clear geometric icon + text chips.
Layouts must prioritize the base-8 grid system. Use compact, high-density industrial cards but maintain generous touch targets (44x44pt).
For the Customer Role Dashboard, prioritize a map-centric architecture. The map takes the top portion (full-bleed) with a bottom sheet overlaying telemetry data.
Use Phosphor icons consistently across all 13 roles. Do not mix outlined and filled weights outside of bottom tab bar active states.
